pathways.label: BPJS pathway
pathways.description: The Mobile JKN guide describes registration with an assigned integrated primary-care facility and requires active membership. Confirm referrals, services, and other requirements with the facility.
required_documents: Membership card or policy summary, if requested by the facility.
Referral and service or payment evidence, when applicable; confirm with the facility.
uncertainties: This list contains verification steps, not confirmation of eligibility or payment.
steps: Confirm service eligibility and benefits with the provider or facility.
Check the network, referral procedure, and payment method before you go.
Check schedules or book online through the facility's official channel.
Ask which documents are required; keep service and payment evidence if requested.
requirements: Active membership and applicable benefits must be confirmed.
Provider network, referral, direct billing, and reimbursement rules depend on policy documents and facility confirmation.
